English: I listen to each student very carefully today.
Spanish: Escucho a cada estudiante muy cuidadosamente hoy.

English: Do you listen to the correct pronunciation? [sing, inf]
Spanish: ¿Escuchas la pronunciación correcta?

English: She listens but speaks with a nervous voice.
Spanish: Ella escucha pero habla con una voz nerviosa.

English: I wait for Rosa and Miguel to arrive.
Spanish: Espero a Rosa y a Miguel.

English: Are you waiting for him, or start now? [sing, inf]
Spanish: ¿Esperas a él, o empezamos ahora?

English: We wait together before the class begins.
Spanish: Esperamos juntos antes de que empiece la clase.

English: I study their faces to understand confusion.
Spanish: Estudio sus caras para entender la confusión.

English: You study the grammar rules much harder. [sing, inf]
Spanish: Estudias las reglas de gramática más duramente.

English: Miguel studies more consistently than anyone else.
Spanish: Miguel estudia más consistentemente que nadie.

English: I explain the conversation activity very clearly.
Spanish: Explico la actividad de conversación muy claramente.

English: Does Rosa explain her answer correctly today?
Spanish: ¿Explica Rosa su respuesta correctamente hoy?

English: You explain things better than the textbook. [sing, inf]
Spanish: Explicas las cosas mejor que el libro.

English: I try to make the class entertaining.
Spanish: Intento hacer la clase entretenida.

English: Do you try to speak only English here? [sing, inf]
Spanish: ¿Intentas hablar sólo inglés aquí?

English: Ana tries her best but sometimes hesitates.
Spanish: Ana intenta su mejor pero a veces vacila.

English: I win their attention with an interesting game.
Spanish: Gano su atención con un juego interesante.

English: Does Francisco win any small prizes ever? [sing, formal]
Spanish: ¿Gana usted algún premio pequeño alguna vez?

English: We win confidence from practicing together daily.
Spanish: Ganamos confianza de practicar juntos diariamente.

English: I speak about my recent travels in Spain.
Spanish: Hablo sobre mis viajes recientes en España.

English: You speak now with much better fluency. [sing, inf]
Spanish: Hablas ahora con mucha mejor fluidez.

English: She speaks more English than at the beginning.
Spanish: Ella habla más inglés que al principio.

English: I need more vocabulary for very advanced topics.
Spanish: Necesito más vocabulario para temas muy avanzados.

English: Do you need a dictionary or translation help? [sing, inf]
Spanish: ¿Necesitas un diccionario o ayuda de traducción?

English: We need to practice pronunciation much more regularly.
Spanish: Necesitamos practicar la pronunciación mucho más regularmente.

English: I look at my notes during every lesson.
Spanish: Miro mis notas durante cada lección.

English: You look very concentrated on each individual word. [sing, inf]
Spanish: Miras muy concentrado en cada palabra.

English: Does he look confused by the conjugations? [sing, formal]
Spanish: ¿Mira usted confundido por las conjugaciones?

English: I show them how to pronounce new words.
Spanish: Les muestro cómo pronunciar las palabras nuevas.

English: Do you show your homework to anyone else? [sing, inf]
Spanish: ¿Muestras tu tarea a alguien más?

English: She shows proper accent on every single syllable.
Spanish: Ella muestra el acento propio en cada sílaba.

English: I call Rosa before each conversation class here.
Spanish: Llamo a Rosa antes de cada clase aquí.

English: You call me with questions about the homework. [sing, inf]
Spanish: Me llamas con preguntas sobre la tarea.

English: Does Miguel call everyone to remind them?
Spanish: ¿Llama Miguel a todos para recordarles?

English: I arrive here every Monday with great enthusiasm.
Spanish: Llego aquí cada lunes con gran entusiasmo.

English: Do you arrive early or exactly on time? [sing, inf]
Spanish: ¿Llegas temprano o exactamente a tiempo?

English: We arrive together and start class immediately now.
Spanish: Llegamos juntos y empezamos la clase inmediatamente.

English: I carry my heavy dictionary and notebook daily.
Spanish: Llevo mi diccionario pesado y cuaderno diariamente.

English: You carry too many books to class here. [sing, inf]
Spanish: Llevas demasiados libros a la clase aquí.

English: She carries her laptop for vocabulary research purposes.
Spanish: Ella lleva su laptop para investigación de vocabulario.

English: I wash my hands before the coffee break.
Spanish: Me lavo las manos antes del descanso.

English: Do you wash your cup after you drink? [sing, inf]
Spanish: ¿Lavas tu taza después de beber?

English: We wash the dishes together right after class.
Spanish: Lavamos los platos juntos inmediatamente después de la clase.

English: I clean my desk before leaving the school.
Spanish: Limpio mi escritorio antes de irme de la escuela.

English: You clean up the table extremely well today. [sing, inf]
Spanish: Limpias muy bien la mesa hoy.

English: We clean the board and erase everything completely.
Spanish: Limpiamos el pizarrón y borramos todo completamente.

English: I send emails with homework assignments every week.
Spanish: Mando correos con tareas asignadas cada semana.

English: Do you send messages to the group chat? [sing, inf]
Spanish: ¿Mandas mensajes al grupo de chat?

English: She sends reminders about next week's class already.
Spanish: Ella manda recordatorios sobre la clase próxima.

English: I invite Rosa to join our small group.
Spanish: Invito a Rosa a unirse a nuestro grupo.

English: Do you invite your friends to participate here? [sing, inf]
Spanish: ¿Invitas a tus amigos a participar aquí?

English: We invite anyone interested in speaking English together.
Spanish: Invitamos a cualquiera interesado en hablar inglés.
